label: No new МС acts on МРЗ or the осигурителен праг in the window
text: ПП № 235 of 29 October (€660 минимум from 1 January 2027) remains the operative text; the МС act register shows nothing newer on minimum wage or the social-insurance ceiling in the 2–3 November window, and ДВ has published no issue since ДВ бр. 99 of 30 October.
